openLink.scheme: Only addresses starting with https are accepted.
openLink.title: Dialog title shown when the app was opened through a link that asks to import a collection or spec.
openLink.invalidTitle: Title when the link cannot be used.
openLink.hostLabel: Label of the website the file comes from.
openLink.addressLabel: Label of the full address of the file.
openLink.detected: {{format}} is the detected file format, for example OpenAPI.
openLink.items: Noun phrase for a number of imported items. Used inside openLink.activeNote.
openLink.activeNote: {{items}} is a counted phrase such as "3 items". Scripts and OAuth settings run code, which is why the user is warned.
openLink.badgeAlt: Alternative text of the "Open in Gostman" badge image.
openLink.builderTitle: Title of a small tool that builds links for a README.
openLink.badgeLabel: Label of a Markdown snippet that shows a badge image.
openLink.import: Button that imports the downloaded collection or spec. Verb.
